newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end flat, outlook seen bullish.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end flat, outlook seen bullish.

text.p: MADRID, June 24 (Reuter) 1510 GMT - Madrid stocks ended flat on Tuesday after an initial slump in prices encouraged buying, with some final investors re-emerging, dealers said. * Short-term outlook still seen bullish, on continual entry of funds into stocks from bonds. Ibex seen headed up to 7,000 * General index sinks 0.31 points, 0.05 percent to 592.08 * Ibex-35 sheds 4.87 points, 0.07 percent, to 6,797.08, but set fresh intraday high at 6,831.69 * Repsol sheds 1.42 percent to 6,270 pesetas as traders took profits. Resistance pegged at 6,250 pesetas * Final clients particularly interested in banks, dealers said. Santander added 50 pesetas to 4,650, BBV rose 30 pesetas to 11,710 and Popular gained 150 pesetas to 33,100.

"We've had a pretty volatile day, with some traders taking profits and final investors in evidence again after staying put for some weeks. Final investors in particular have been interested in banks," said a dealer at a Spanish brokerage.

Also in focus were stocks due to be incorporated into the blue chip index as of July 1. Steel tubing firm Tubacex gained 26 pesetas to 466, Asturiana del Zinc fell 15 pesetas to 2,825 and Viscofan rose 185 pesetas to 3,435.
"With the expiry of the special (cleansed black market) debt next week, we'll get fresh funds coming into the market, so the outlook is good," the dealer added.
